entity_types.name: agent_role
entity_types.desc: A functional role in a multi-agent workflow, such as portfolio manager (PM), bull/bear debater, or calibrated compaction judge.

entity_types.name: cli_agent
entity_types.desc: Any command-line coding agent that can act as a worker under admission control and trust-ladder supervision.

entity_types.name: compaction_decision
entity_types.desc: A keep-or-drop judgment over agent context content, made semantically rather than by character count.

entity_types.name: diary_entry
entity_types.desc: An append-only markdown record written per settled turn into a local git repository, containing tool mix, event mix, closing words, duration, and end reason.

entity_types.name: dsh_plugin
entity_types.desc: A DeepSeek Harness plugin repository in the vicfei family, such as dsh-ai-hedge-fund, dsh-auto-ontology, dsh-CCXT, or dsh-compaction-semantic.

entity_types.name: evidence_tag
entity_types.desc: A source quote or citation attached to a claim, entity, or relation, enforcing the family's no-evidence-no-assertion discipline.

entity_types.name: format_spec
entity_types.desc: An executable schema or FORMAT.md document describing a reverse-engineered file format, carrying a verification status such as verified-byte-equal, semantic-equal, or hypothesis.

entity_types.name: git_repository
entity_types.desc: A user-owned local git repo (GitHub/Gitea/bare) where plugins persist diary entries or evidence ledgers.

entity_types.name: guardrail
entity_types.desc: A fail-closed safety mechanism enforced in code, such as the triple-armed trading guard with notional caps and symbol whitelist.

entity_types.name: harness_event
entity_types.desc: A durable event emitted by the DeepSeek Harness session/event stream, such as turn/end, session/disposed, blocked, interrupted, or forked.

entity_types.name: harness_service
entity_types.desc: A named, optional service slot in the DeepSeek Harness engine, such as the tool-result pruner resolved by name.

entity_types.name: investor_persona
entity_types.desc: A named investor archetype (Buffett, Munger, Lynch, Wood) that independently values a ticker within the hedge-fund committee.

entity_types.name: ledger_entry
entity_types.desc: A hash-chained JSON row in the evidence ledger recording a session transition with id, ts, kind, payload, prevHash, and entryHash.

entity_types.name: market_data_payload
entity_types.desc: A read-only data record returned from an exchange or data source, carrying its source and timestamp.

entity_types.name: ontology_component
entity_types.desc: A structural element of a constructed ontology, such as an entity type, relation type, TBox, or ABox.

entity_types.name: output_artifact
entity_types.desc: A produced deliverable with a defined format, such as an IC-MEMO, a typed ontology (TBox+ABox), or a compaction result.

entity_types.name: profile
entity_types.desc: A harness installation profile (e.g. web, default) that determines which plugins are loaded.

entity_types.name: roundtrip_gate
entity_types.desc: The verification step that decodes a sample, re-encodes it, and compares byte-for-byte to classify format knowledge.

entity_types.name: ticket
entity_types.desc: An approval artifact used in admission control, e.g. a WeChat single-digit approval that authorizes an agent action.

entity_types.name: trust_ladder
entity_types.desc: The admission-control progression (off → observe → auto) governing whether and how autonomously a CLI agent may start work.

entity_types.name: type_conflict
entity_types.desc: An organically detected inconsistency between ontology types that is flagged rather than silently dropped.

entity_types.name: upstream_project
entity_types.desc: An external open-source project that a dsh plugin is inspired by, built on, or implements the concept of, e.g. virattt/ai-hedge-fund, NVIDIA/auto-ontology, ccxt.

relation_types.name: inspired_by
relation_types.desc: A dsh plugin is inspired by or implements the concept of an upstream project.

relation_types.name: built_on
relation_types.desc: A dsh plugin is technically built on an upstream library or project.

relation_types.name: sister_of
relation_types.desc: Two dsh plugins belong to the same family and are cross-referenced as sister projects.

relation_types.name: has_persona
relation_types.desc: A hedge-fund plugin includes named investor personas that value tickers independently.

relation_types.name: has_role
relation_types.desc: A plugin defines agent roles that participate in its workflow.

relation_types.name: produces
relation_types.desc: A plugin emits a formatted deliverable as its output.

relation_types.name: carries_evidence
relation_types.desc: An output artifact attaches evidence tags to its claims, entities, or relations.

relation_types.name: enforces
relation_types.desc: A plugin enforces a fail-closed guardrail in its bridge code.

relation_types.name: returns
relation_types.desc: A market-data plugin returns payloads annotated with exchange and timestamp.

relation_types.name: contains
relation_types.desc: A constructed ontology artifact contains entity types, relation types, TBox and ABox components.

relation_types.name: flags
relation_types.desc: An ontology plugin detects and flags type conflicts instead of silently dropping them.

relation_types.name: makes
relation_types.desc: A calibrated judge role makes semantic keep-or-drop decisions over context.

relation_types.name: resolves
relation_types.desc: A plugin fills an optional name-based service slot in the harness engine.

relation_types.name: subscribes_to
relation_types.desc: A plugin listens to a harness event stream such as session/event.

relation_types.name: writes_entry_to
relation_types.desc: A plugin appends diary or ledger entries into a user-owned git repository.

relation_types.name: produces
relation_types.desc: A plugin emits a diary entry per settled turn.

relation_types.name: produces
relation_types.desc: A plugin appends a hash-chained ledger entry per session transition.

relation_types.name: triggered_by
relation_types.desc: A diary entry is created when a settled turn/end event with a completing reason is emitted.

relation_types.name: chains_to
relation_types.desc: Each ledger entry references the previous entry's hash, forming a tamper-evident chain.

relation_types.name: governs
relation_types.desc: The trust ladder determines the autonomy level granted to a CLI agent.

relation_types.name: authorizes
relation_types.desc: A ticket grants approval for an agent to start or continue work.

relation_types.name: verified_by
relation_types.desc: A format spec's knowledge status is established by passing the roundtrip gate.

relation_types.name: installs_into
relation_types.desc: A plugin is installed into a specific harness profile such as web or default.
